source.what: mean seconds of each test on main, from the ci database. A test has the time of the first of 'configurations' in which main runs it. Under 'files': test file, then class; 'tests' lists the tests of at least 0.1s by name, 'others' is how many shorter tests the class has and 'others_seconds' their time together.
source.query:
SELECT t.file AS file, t.suite AS suite, t.case_name AS case_name, h.mean_duration_milliseconds AS ms
FROM ci.health AS h
INNER JOIN ci.tests AS t FINAL ON h.tests_id = t.id
WHERE h.environments_id = {environments_id} AND h.env_vars_id = {env_vars_id}
  AND h.ran_on = 'main' AND h.window = '7d'
  AND t.repo = 'pytorch/pytorch' AND t.language = 'python'
  AND cityHash64(t.file) % 2 = {half}
source.query_note: run for each of 'configurations' and for {half} = 0 and 1
